title: Head-state exit label
statement: Let $k,L$ be natural numbers and let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine. A head state of type $cA(\tau,t_0)$ exits to the cell template with parameters $\tau,t_0$ and phase $2$, while one of type $cB(\tau,t_0)$ exits to the corresponding cell template at phase $4$. A state $iz(t_0)$ exits to the counter label for $iu(t_0)$ at phase $0$, and a state $iu(t_0)$ exits to the $eT$ label with bit $t_0$. The state $lay$ exits to the final template at program counter $0$.
hypotheses_covered: a finite Boolean Turing machine M
